summary.result: The new construction of the housing with building energy efficiency rating level 1+++ induces 261.5 and 76.8 trillion won of production and value-added respectively, and the induced employment is 82.1 ten thousand person.
summary.background: The improvement of building energy efficiency rating increases the effect on production inducement, but decreases that on value-added inducement and employment inducement.
